hero_kpi_rationale: VST has signed 20-year PPA agreements with Meta (2,609 MW) and AWS (1,200 MW) to supply carbon-free nuclear energy to cloud data centers, reflecting the structural growth in energy demand driven by cloud operations and AI.

kpis.short: Contrats long-terme avec Meta et AWS
kpis.explanation_en: Total power contracted through 20-year PPAs with Meta and Amazon Web Services to power cloud data centers.
kpis.description: VST has entered into 20-year PPAs with Meta (2,609 MW from PJM nuclear plants, delivery between late 2026 and late 2027) and AWS (1,200 MW from Comanche Peak, delivery between Q4 2027 and 2032).
kpis.signal: Demonstrates VST's strategic position in supporting the growth of data and AI.

kpis.explanation_en: Total electricity generation capacity of the company, measured in megawatts.
kpis.description: VST's total generation capacity is 44,000 MW, sourced from a diversified portfolio including natural gas, nuclear, coal, solar, and battery storage.
kpis.signal: Indicates the scale and scope of the company's power generation operations.

kpis.explanation_en: Total number of residential, commercial, and industrial customers served by the company.
kpis.description: VST serves approximately 5 million retail customers for electricity and natural gas across 16 U.S. states and the District of Columbia.
kpis.signal: Indicates the reach of the company's retail market footprint.

kpis.explanation_en: Investment-grade credit rating assigned by rating agencies.
kpis.description: In December 2025, S&P upgraded Vistra's credit rating to BBB- (investment grade) from BB+ previously, reflecting improved financial profile.
kpis.signal: Improved credit quality and access to capital markets.

kpis.explanation_en: Total amount of dividends paid to common shareholders during the year.
kpis.description: Vistra paid $306 million in dividends to common shareholders in 2025.
kpis.signal: Direct return to shareholders and indication of strong cash flow.

kpis.explanation_en: Total amount of common shares repurchased by the company.
kpis.description: Vistra repurchased 6.6 million shares for approximately $1 billion in 2025. The cumulative program has repurchased 167 million shares for $5.9 billion since 2021, with $1.8 billion of remaining authorization.
kpis.signal: Return to shareholders and indication of management confidence in valuation.

kpis.name_en: Meta PPA Agreement: 2,609 MW of Nuclear Power
kpis.explanation_en: 20-year PPA signed in January 2026 with Meta Platforms to supply carbon-free nuclear energy from PJM plants.
kpis.description: VST has entered into a 20-year PPA with Meta to supply 2,609 MW of carbon-free power and capacity from its Perry, Davis-Besse, and Beaver Valley nuclear plants in PJM, with phased delivery between late 2026 and late 2034.
kpis.signal: Demonstrates ability to meet sustainable energy needs of cloud and AI giants.

kpis.name_en: AWS PPA Agreement: 1,200 MW from Comanche Peak
kpis.explanation_en: 20-year PPA signed in September 2025 with Amazon Web Services to supply 1,200 MW of carbon-free power from the Comanche Peak nuclear plant.
kpis.description: VST has entered into a 20-year PPA with Amazon Web Services to supply 1,200 MW of carbon-free power from its Comanche Peak nuclear plant, with delivery starting Q4 2027 and full capacity by 2032.
kpis.signal: Highlights VST's strategic role in supporting AWS's sustainability and data growth objectives.

kpis.explanation_en: Acquisition of Cogentrix Energy comprising 10 natural gas generation facilities totaling 5,500 MW of capacity.
kpis.description: VST signed definitive agreements in December 2025 to acquire Cogentrix Energy, including 10 modern natural gas facilities (CCGT and CT) totaling 5,500 MW across PJM, ISO-NE, and ERCOT. Closing expected mid-to-late 2026.
kpis.signal: Significant and diversified expansion of natural gas generation capacity across multiple ISO regions.

kpis.explanation_en: Acquisition completed in October 2025 of 7 natural gas facilities totaling 2,600 MW across PJM, ISO-NE, NYISO, and CAISO.
kpis.description: Vistra acquired 100% of the interests in Lotus subsidiaries in October 2025, adding 7 natural gas facilities totaling 2,600 MW in Delaware, Pennsylvania, Rhode Island, New York, and California for a base price of $1.9 billion.
kpis.signal: Significant geographic diversification of natural gas portfolio and multi-regional expansion.

risks.title: Cybersecurity
risks.summary: Cybersecurity is a major risk for Vistra, which is taking progressive measures to manage it
risks.score_rationale: The company identifies cybersecurity as a significant risk with regular oversight by the Sustainability and Risk Committee, training for directors, and appointed in 2023 a director with cybersecurity expertise (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Regulation
risks.summary: Federal and regional regulations can have a significant impact on business operations and profitability
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a regulated environment including FERC, ERCOT, ISO-NE, NYISO, CAISO, and strict environmental regulations (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Supply Chain and Labor Shortages
risks.summary: Supply and labor constraints can affect the economic feasibility and timing of expansion projects
risks.score_rationale: The industry faces persistent supply chain constraints, labor shortages, extended lead times, and rising labor costs (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Geopolitical Risks (Russian Uranium)
risks.summary: VST has contracted nuclear fuel supply through 2030 without reliance on Russian deliveries; current impact limited due to proactive action
risks.score_rationale: The Russia-Ukraine conflict and the PRUI Act create uncertainties around uranium supply. Russia temporarily suspended shipments in November 2024 (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Operational Risks of Nuclear Facilities
risks.summary: Operational risks could affect VST's ability to fulfill its major long-term PPA contracts
risks.score_rationale: Nuclear plant safety and operational reliability are critical; any incident would have significant impacts on production and reputation (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Competition in Electricity Retail
risks.summary: Competition may affect retail customer retention and commercial margins
risks.score_rationale: Electricity retail is a competitive market with multiple suppliers; VST competes on price, customer service, and innovative offerings (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Energy Transition and Asset Impairment
risks.summary: The energy transition may create asset impairment risks for traditional generation assets
risks.score_rationale: The portfolio includes coal assets (Coleto Creek, Miami Fort) and there is regulatory/market risk of impairment (default score, to be refined)
